bio: The Asian restaurant at the Grischa hotel serves a combination of Chinese and Japanese dishes. Tip: Some dishes are designed for sharing. If you fancy the Peking duck for two, which is absolutely to be recommended, be sure to pre-order (at least 48hr in advance). You also have the option of taking your pick of many of the ingredients and having them put together as you wish. The sleek, authentic design of the restaurant is also appealing....
